comments.author: buildsjets
comments.story: Can You Stop a Hypersonic Missile?
comments.why: Sprint scored kinetic kills in testing at Kwajalein.
comments.text: Everyone keeps saying that Sprint was a nuke. That is true. However, it also scored some kinetic kills during testing at Kwajalein. [VIDEO] I'm pretty sure that improvements in sensing, computation, actuation, and conventional warhead design over the past 50 years could have produced a reliable hit-to-kill Sprint. And in fact, some research was done on such a vehicle, the McDonnell-Douglas HEDI. [LINK]
